needed.evidence: A wide, unpaved strip of dirt and gravel runs between the road and the buildings, with no continuous, purpose-built sidewalk.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, paved footway on the left side to provide a safe, level surface for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: The area to the right of the road is an unpaved, uneven shoulder with no defined pedestrian path.
needed.suggestion: Build a paved footway on the right side to separate pedestrians from the carriageway.

needed.evidence: The unpaved path on the left is uneven and appears to have ruts and loose material, creating a significant trip hazard.
needed.suggestion: Resurface the left-side path with a smooth, even material to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: The unpaved area on the right is uneven and has visible ruts, posing a trip hazard for anyone walking there.
needed.suggestion: Grade and pave the right-side path to create a safe, even walking surface.

needed.evidence: There is a clear junction on the right where a side road meets the main road, but no pedestrian crossing is provided.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at the junction on the right to provide a safe place for people to cross.
